name: io.github.intelligentnode/intellinode
description: Cross-provider LLM tools for coding assistants: ask, consensus, code review, fixes, tests, components, SQL, OpenAPI, design tokens, regex, mock data, SEO meta and image generation on OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Cohere, NVIDIA, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Groq, xAI, Together or a local Ollama model.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI API key (chat tools and image generation)

environmentVariables.name: NVIDIA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: NVIDIA NIM API key (DeepSeek, Llama and other hosted models)

environmentVariables.name: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenRouter API key (hundreds of models through one key)

environmentVariables.name: TOGETHER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Together AI API key (set TOGETHER_MODEL too)

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_MODEL
environmentVariables.description: Model name served by a local Ollama instance, for example qwen3 (no key needed)
